title: Šakotis
description: A home-oven adaptation of spit-baked Lithuanian šakotis; the authentic branching appearance requires a rotating spit.

steps.instruction: Beat the listed ingredients until pale and light; ensure butter and eggs are at room temperature when specified.
Gently fold in the remaining dry or wet ingredients just until homogeneous, without deflating the mixture.

For a home-oven adaptation of traditional spit-baked šakotis, spread the batter in several very thin successive layers, baking each briefly until lightly golden. Continue until all batter is used; the tree-like spit shape will not be reproduced.
Bake in a preheated 180°C oven for about 55 minutes until set, golden and cooked through. Cool on a rack.
Finish with the listed ingredients, check seasoning and serve immediately.
